errors.detail:
Gate voice-consistency (check-report-voice.js) returned non-zero. Output excerpt:

check-report-voice: /Users/tomcranstoun/Documents/GitHub/MX-hub/mx-outputs/audit/2026-06-02/specification.website/spec-website-report.md
  2 mixed-voice section(s). Every section should pick one register and hold it. Mixing third-person ("the site does X") with first-person ("we found Y") inside the same section reads as drafted-by-committee.

  ## About This Report  (line 10)
    first-person tokens: 9 (lines 12, 14, 16…)
    third-person markers: 1 (lines 18)

  ## Div Soup: naked containers without semantic mapping  (line 481)
    first-person tokens: 2 (lines 485, 511)
    third-person markers: 1 (lines 537)

  Fix: rewrite the section in a single voice. Most audit-report sections use first-person consultant voice ("we"); scorecards and appendices use third-person.

errors.title: Scope mis-statements remain after auto-repair: 1
errors.detail:
Gate sample-vs-total-scope (check-report-scope.js) returned non-zero. Output excerpt:

check-report-scope: /Users/tomcranstoun/Documents/GitHub/MX-hub/mx-outputs/audit/2026-06-02/specification.website/spec-website-report.md
  1 scope mis-statement(s).

  [sitewide-inside-sampled-section] line 156
    section: ## Findings  (line 144)
    phrase:  "on every page"
    line:    The pipeline scores 91/100 with two checks flagged. Inline Tag Bloat fires on all 11 pages: each carries a 918-byte inli

  Fix: site-wide artefact sections (sitemap, robots, llms.txt, agent-card, security headers) describe a single file; do not write "across the audited set" — write "the sitemap declares" or "this file carries". Per-page sampled sections (Findings, Accessibility, Performance, SEO) describe N audited pages; do not write "site-wide" or "across the entire site" — write "across the audited pages" or "on the audited set".
